ns2:section.sectionText: This year long project will consist of a lab based creative process culminating in community outreach performances at the end of the Spring 2018 semester. The theme of this course is to examine cultural collisions in reference to physical practice, choreographic methodologies, and the phenomenology of performance through the collaborative creation of a new work with Assistant Professor of Dance, Abby Zbikowski. It will meet T/R from 11am-1230pm in DRK for the Fall semester and is 1 credit
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance major(s). Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
